researched.name: TAAL Tech Ltd
researched.reason: Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue Rs 68.63 cr (+40.6% YoY) and PAT Rs 21.23 cr (+48.8%), H1 revenue +41.1% and PAT +45.3%, against FY26 growth of just +6.6% and +16.3% - a six-fold acceleration in two quarters. Held to MEDIUM confidence, not high, because the company explains nothing - no presentation, no concall, no guidance, no order book, no headcount since March - and because a third of revenue sits in two unnamed customers, 99.8% of revenue is export, Rs 5 cr is still lent to its own holding company, and median daily turnover is Rs 21 lakh.

researched.name: Kopran Ltd
researched.reason: Real improvement, but off a loss base and with margins still below the company's own recent average. From its Q2 FY27 investor presentation: Q2 revenue Rs 211.26 cr against Rs 117.91 cr (+79.2%) with net profit of Rs 4.39 cr against a LOSS of Rs 9.92 cr; H1 revenue Rs 365.26 cr (+44.3%) and PAT Rs 11.10 cr against a loss of Rs 2.47 cr. The problem is the quality: the Q2 EBITDA margin of 8.62% and the H1 margin of 9.34% are both BELOW the 11.48% the company did in FY26, so the recovery is volume, not operating gain, and finance costs doubled (Rs 4.25 cr in the quarter against Rs 2.09 cr). On TTM PAT of about Rs 39.3 cr the stock is on roughly 30x - a higher multiple than TAAL Tech for a lower-quality beat. The market agreed: +1.9% on the day and -8.2% over 20 sessions.

researched.name: Aelea Commodities Ltd
researched.reason: A properly sized capex filing that still does not clear the bar. The board approved acquisition of about 14,268 sq m at Vasravi, Surat, adding 60 MT of manufacturing capacity plus a new 30 MT cardanol processing unit, and a staff housing colony, for an estimated Rs 114.00 cr (Rs 100.00 cr land and plant, Rs 14.00 cr housing) - 45.1% of the Rs 252.7 cr market cap. THE PYTHON-INTERPRETER TRAP RECURRED FOR A FIFTH RUN AND WAS CAUGHT BEFORE IT COULD DO HARM THIS TIME. Step 0 of the routine prompt says `pip install --quiet pymupdf`, but on this VM `pip` belongs to Python 3.13 while /usr/local/bin/python3 - the interpreter that runs every builder - is Python 3.11.18. The install reported 'Requirement already satisfied' into /usr/local/lib/python3.13/site-packages and `import fitz` still failed. It was spotted at the step-0 verification, before any builder ran, and fixed with `python3 -m pip install --quiet pymupdf xlrd`; fitz and xlrd both imported afterwards and every builder ran clean. SUGGESTED FIX, now five runs old: change step 0 of the routine prompt from `pip install --quiet pymupdf` to `python3 -m pip install --quiet pymupdf xlrd`.

THE IDEAS PAGE COULD NOT BE RENDERED IN A BROWSER FOR THE SHIP-IT CHECK, and the reason is by design, not a bug. docs/ideas.html was served locally and loaded in headless Chromium at 1280x900 and at 375x780. The page is owner-gated: it renders 'This page is private - It's a personal research tool of the site owner' and fetches its gate from a Supabase RPC (sw_kv_get) that this sandbox's proxy refuses, so no card can be displayed here. That is a real check of the data this run produced, but it is NOT a visual check of the live page, and that distinction is stated rather than blurred.

The FY2025-26 narrative states the two-customer total as Rs 5,734.36 lakh for FY26 - which is FY25's figure, repeated verbatim - while the table immediately below gives Rs 4,572.48 lakh + Rs 1,897.74 lakh = Rs 6,470.22 lakh for FY26. ONE FETCH IN THE UPDATES SWEEP FAILED ON OUR SIDE AND WAS RECOVERED. The download list was built by splitting queue lines on '|', and Shining Tools' filing subject contains a literal newline ('Announcement Under Regulation 30 Regarding Imposition Of\nFines.'), which split one row into two and produced a bogus request for a file named '16_Fines._.pdf'. The real filing had already downloaded correctly as item 15 and was read; on reading it, it proved to be the BSE fine letter dated 31-Oct-2026 that the 2026-11-02 run had already written up, so no duplicate update was created. No information was lost, but the list-building step needs to stop splitting on a field that can contain newlines.
